Diving headfirst into the high-energy world of fitness, he sets out to capture the grit, the sweat, and the breathtaking forms of the city’s most dedicated athletes.

But as he spends more time behind the lens, he discovers that there is a magnetic tension between the photographer and the model that no manual can prepare him for.

What begins as a professional quest for the perfect shot soon turns into an intimate game of seduction.

As the sessions heat up and the boundaries begin to blur, he’ll find out just how quickly a simple 'click' can lead to something much more... spicy.
